changelog:
Initial release of Gmail Lead Desk — standalone sales and customer support workflow for Gmail via AISA gateway.

- Connect Gmail accounts using OAuth and AISA API key.
- Scan unread leads, summarize inquiry/support threads, draft template replies (draft-only by default), and archive with labels.
- Workflow routing for connecting, summarizing, drafting, sending (with confirmation), and archiving emails.
- Built-in safety: no auto-send, explicit user confirmation for key actions, and restricted bulk operations.
- Troubleshooting and reference guides included for common issues and detailed workflows.
